Case: Patient D is an 86-year-old Hispanic man with history of multiple myeloma who presents with 6 months of progressive neck pain and limb weakness. Patient D is also requiring more assistance to ambulate, citing that he is feeling weakness of his arms and legs. NSAIDs have not provided any pain relief. There are also innumerable osteolytic lesions throughout the visible spine segments.
Question: Would you offer morphine to Patient D? Yes or No? If yes, how much supply would you give – Low (1 week), or High (4 weeks) supply? Explain.
